title: Adjunctions between the functors on presheaves attached to an adjoint pair of functors

difficulty_reason: The lemma collects five consequences of a functor being right adjoint to another: the direct image of a representable presheaf is representable, two auxiliary categories of morphisms have initial respectively final objects, and the functors on presheaves are identified with the corresponding functors attached to the adjoint (statement lines 4400-4412). The proof treats the parts in turn: part (1) is an adjunction computation (proof lines 4415-4418); parts (2) and (3) exhibit the initial and final objects through the unit and counit and verify their universal properties (proof lines 4421-4436); parts (4) and (5) are further adjunction computations and a uniqueness argument (proof lines 4438-4453). The non-formal content is the two explicit computations. The claim is H1/H2: five short verifications, each written out.
